summary: 7 x 6 band whose high side face carries the wheel in stones: 12 marquise sapphires 1.5 x 3 pointing out along the spokes as the lights, 12 round rubies 1.25 between their heads as the foils, each in a collet set through, inside sunk hub and rim mouldings.
